notes: Most graduate-school guidelines (Engineering e3, Information Science and Technology, Science, Environmental Science, Agriculture, Chemical Sciences and Engineering, Life Science, Economics) are PDFs, so eligibility, English scores and dates in them could not be quoted; only the HTML program pages were used. The HTML application periods found for e3, IST, Science and Agriculture all end before 29 Oct 2026, so no deadline is recorded for them. The Graduate School of Environmental Science (EPEES, GEM) lists a master's spring entrance examination application period of January 6 to January 13, 2027 on its own page (https://www.ees.hokudai.ac.jp/?page_id=2726&lang=en), not quoted because the programme snapshot is the global.hokudai.ac.jp page. Advanced Graduate School of Chemistry and Materials Science (AGS) and One Health are doctoral only and were skipped; Economics lists only exchange (special auditor) routes in HTML; Japanese-taught Education and Fisheries pages state requirements only in PDF or are robots-blocked.

programs.name: English Engineering Education Program (e3), Graduate School of Engineering - Master's course

academic.text: Meets nationality and educational qualification requirements; high academic performance (e.g. average of 80% or higher / 3.0 or higher on a 4-point GPA scale)
academic.quote: Have high academic performance (e.g., average of 80% or higher / 3.0 or higher on a 4-point GPA scale)

prerequisites.text: Official English test scores designated by e3, or a certificate of Medium of Instruction, as proof of English proficiency
prerequisites.quote: Submit official English test scores as designated by e3 or a certificate of Medium of Instruction as proof of English proficiency.

programs.name: Global Education Program for Agriscience Frontiers, Graduate School of Agriculture - Master's course

academic.text: Bachelor's degree or equivalent (or expected), at least 16 years of education, and a GPA of at least 2.30 on a 3.00 scale in the most recent program
academic.quote:
Applicants must hold (or are expected to receive) a bachelor’s degree or equivalent and have completed at least 16 years of education.
Applicants are required to have obtained a GPA requirement of 2.30 (3.00 as full score) during the applicant’s most recently graduated/ expected to graduate program.

prerequisites.text: English at CEFR B2 or higher in each of the four skills on a qualification or certification test
prerequisites.quote:
Applicants are required to have a score of at least B2 equivalent of the Common European Framework of
Reference for Languages (CEFR) in each of the four skills (listening, reading, speaking, and
writing) on a qualification or certification test.
